conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: (Maybe ask Hans? "Hans, we suspect")

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Recall this face

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "The person we need to find is inside the kitchen"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Someone is hiding from us" #Taps arm

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Hans says expressionlessly, "Then I'll search," and immediately slams the wooden door open with his shoulder, sending splintered panels flying inward. The chefs and helpers in the kitchen panic, shouting "What are you doing?!!!" Hans swiftly strikes, using precise hand chops to the back of their necks. Several people slump to the floor one after another, and the kitchen falls silent, with only the bubbling of a pot on the stove remaining. Hans turns to player4 and asks expressionlessly what features the person they're looking for has, and if it's these three kitchen staff.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Little Tang saw it." "You can ask her." "It should be a person wearing black clothes, but the specific facial details need to be asked from Little Tang."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Black trench coat, complexion relatively pale." "Man."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Hans says "Understood" and begins carefully searching the kitchen. He checks the ventilation ducts to confirm no signs of loosening, opens all cabinets to find only neatly arranged utensils, and rummages through the pile of ingredients in the corner without finding anyone hidden. Finally, he straightens up and shakes his head; there is indeed no one hiding in the kitchen.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "This... doesn't make sense."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh??" "Hans, your place, it's not haunted, is it?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Hans shakes his head indicating he doesn't know. Hans turns to ask about the next course of action, while gesturing with his eyes towards the unconscious people on the floor. He stands in place waiting for instructions, his right hand resting on the equipment belt at his waist.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "(We can observe the starting point for now, it feels like it's haunted.)"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: .rh

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: All things are impermanent, fate is uncertain, only a few know where the truth lies. Secret Dice Delivery from the group <The Horror of the Orient Express> (QQ-Group:966287630): Alright, alright, I'm going to roll... <player2>'s roll: D100=80 - Not bad.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: A waiter carrying a tray arrives at the kitchen door, sees the collapsed people and scattered utensils inside, screams "Help!!!", drops the tray with a clatter, and turns to run outside.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "What happened?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Things have gone bad, let's run."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The customers and waiters in the restaurant turn their heads at the sound and gradually gather towards the kitchen. Those Turkish customers wearing red fezzes also stand up and follow the crowd to check the situation. The crowd blocks the kitchen door tightly. A manager in a suit squeezes to the front and asks, "What's going on, sir?" Hans doesn't speak, just silently places his hand on his waist, calmly scanning the gathering crowd.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Ah, it's like this, my friend here" #points at Little Tang "seems to have had their money stolen."

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "Right, I know this person too, I can also vouch" #patting chest

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We chased him all the way to the kitchen." "But the thief disappeared." "It was a man in a black trench coat with a pale face." "And then this friend" #points at Hans "he, uh, has a bit of a temper, sorry."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The manager raises his voice, "What? Someone stole your money in this kitchen? But you didn't need to knock out all our chefs, how are we supposed to do business!" He spreads his arms pointing at the chefs on the floor, his face showing both anger and disbelief. The manager clenches his fist and shouts, "If you don't provide reasonable compensation, I will resort to the Blackshirts!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Looks at Hans

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: (So, should we have Hans compensate or intimidate?) A Turk suddenly pulls out a thick wad of banknotes and stuffs it into the manager's hand, saying loudly, "Ah, my friend made a mistake, player4, player6, how could you be so careless! Ah, is that strong man your new friend? Everyone, disperse!" Seeing the matter settled, the crowd gradually disperses. Those Turks wearing red fezzes quickly surround player4, player6, and Hans, forming a moving wall trying to lead them towards a corner of the restaurant.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Three Turks press daggers against their backs, ordering in a low voice, "Move outside!" The cold pressure of the blade tip comes through their clothes. Hans quickly glances at player4 and player6, his eyebrows slightly raised, his right-hand fingers gently flexing twice at his side, maintaining a posture ready to counterattack at any moment.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Remaining alert, obediently follows outside for now.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Take the three strong men to hide in a corner.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Let's go.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The six arrive on the street, the Bora wind making it hard to keep their eyes open. The lead Turk gestures into the distance, and a black car quickly pulls up and stops in front of them. The car door slides open with a clatter, and another Turk reaches out to push the three into the car.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Snapped fingers

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Three burly men suddenly rushed out from behind the restaurant, their fists whistling as they lunged at the Turks, their momentum even overpowering the howling Bora.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player6 is precisely stabbed in the heart by the dagger; she staggers back two steps, looking down at the blood gushing from her chest. The blood, caught in the Bora wind, turns into a crimson mist of rain, splattering onto everyone's cheeks and clothes. Her fingers press futilely against the wound, her pupils gradually dilating. She takes one last look at the gloomy sky before slowly collapsing into the pool of blood. The wind still howls, unable to disperse the thick scent of iron and the silent sorrow in the air.
